hooks.name: Pre-Task-Completion Checks
hooks.description: Before a spec task is marked completed, verifies tests pass, no secrets are committed, and relevant documentation is updated (Kiro University Lesson 3, Hook D).

action.prompt: A spec task was just completed. Before moving on, verify: (1) backend unit + property tests pass (`python -m pytest backend/tests -q`); (2) the destination dataset validates (`python data/scripts/validate.py`) if data changed; (3) no secrets or .env files with values are staged/committed (scan for AWS keys, tokens); (4) relevant documentation (README, docs/, spec) is updated to reflect the change. Report any failures clearly and do not silently pass.
